notes: Heavily agglutinative/particle-driven course: the bulk of flags are FPs — verb-endings and case particles (해요, 거예요, 없어요, 에, 를, 고, 는) sliced as 'component' sub-glosses with many contextual English faces (86 fp_subgloss), plus the LEGO-debut-vs-BUILD and statement-vs-question artifacts where the same English lemma just gains an article/object/time-filler or do-support (101 fp_inflection). The only genuine learner-facing ZUT issues are two recurring modal/desiderative overloads — 해야 obligation glossed need-to vs must, and 싶지 않아요 glossed don't-want-to vs wouldn't-like-to (7 high-severity, drilled across multiple seeds) — plus the 알다 know/find-out fork, 일 work/job, and three single-row wrong-data glosses (어떻게→'this word in English', 좋은→'more slowly', 다시→'could').
